## Natural history notes

A small jumping spider characterized by its compact body, short legs, dark coloration, and two pale “flag-like” markings on the abdomen. In Florida, it is found in leaf litter, gardens, yards, hammocks, pine flatwoods, forest edges, and other areas with low vegetation or ground cover. It is active during the day and hunts small insects and other invertebrates by stalking and jumping on prey rather than using a web to capture food.
